instruction: EV (Electric Vehicle) aur Hybrid car me kya antar hota hai?
output:
EV (Electric Vehicle) aur Hybrid car me mukhya antar:

1. Powertrain: EV me koi petrol ya diesel engine nahi hota, ye 100% battery aur electric motor se chalti hai. Hybrid me petrol/diesel engine aur electric motor dono hote hain.
2. Charging: EV ko external charger ya charging station par plug-in karna padta hai. Strong/Mild Hybrid battery ko engine aur regenerative braking se khud charge kar leti hai.
3. Fuel & Emissions: EV zero tailpipe emissions deti hai. Hybrid fuel consume karti hai lekin conventional ICE car se 30-40% zyada mileage deti hai.
4. Range Anxiety: EV me charging infrastructure par depend hona padta hai; Hybrid me conventional fuel tank hone se long distance travel bilkul normal petrol car jaisa rehta hai.

instruction: What is the difference between On-Road Price and Ex-Showroom Price?
output:
Ex-Showroom Price is the base price set by the manufacturer including manufacturing cost and GST, but excluding road registration and legal requirements.

On-Road Price is the final amount payable to legally drive the car on public roads. It includes:
• Ex-Showroom Price
• State RTO Registration & Road Tax (varies by state from 4% to 18%)
• Mandatory Motor Insurance (1-year Own Damage + 3-year Third Party)
• Fastag & State Municipal Road Safety Cess
• 1% TCS (Tax Collected at Source) on cars priced above ₹10 Lakhs
• Optional dealer handling charges, extended warranty, and accessories.
